### Expected-drift set

Two commits, each touching `desktop-theme-home` (`modules/desktop/theme-home.nix`),
a registry key consumed only by `hosts/sweet16/home.nix` and
`hosts/petunia/home.nix` (confirmed via `consumers.sh desktop-theme-home`).
Expected drift for both ranges is sweet16 + petunia only.

- `9030c61..d06007b`: adds an `lib.mkAfter` `programs.tmux.extraConfig` block
  restating status/pane-border color directives from the stylix palette.

  now overridable. Expected drift: sweet16, petunia only; the mkDefault
  softening must be zero-drift everywhere it isn't overridden (avina, hermes,
